name: ricwiz
description: Helps create branches for ticket development

commands.title: Ricwiz: Open Merge Requests in Browser
Ricwiz: Open Merge Requests in VS Code
Ricwiz: Open Jira Ticket in Browser
Ricwiz: Open Jira Ticket in VS Code

ricwiz.jiraUrl.description: Base URL for Jira tickets (e.g., https://jira.company.com/browse/). Leave empty to disable.

ricwiz.workflowStyle.description: Defines the branching strategy to use (Standard single-repo vs Multi-Remote).

ricwiz.upstreamRemote.description: The name of the remote to fetch base branches from (e.g., 'salesforce-master' or 'upstream'). Used only in multi-remote workflow. Tip: Run 'git remote -v' in your terminal to list your exact remote names.

ricwiz.originRemote.description: The name of the remote to push your branches to (e.g., 'cdb' or 'origin'). Used only in multi-remote workflow. Tip: Run 'git remote -v' in your terminal to list your exact remote names.

ricwiz.ticketSourceBranch.description: The base branch from which ticket branches are created (e.g., main, develop).

ricwiz.gitlabUrlOverride.description: Base URL of the company's GitLab repository (e.g., https://gitlab.company.com/group/project). Leave empty for the extension to discover it automatically via git remote.

ricwiz.packageXmlCommand.description: The command used to generate the package.xml file. Use {baseBranch} as a placeholder for the ticket source branch.

ricwiz.deployCommand.default: sf project deploy start --manifest package/package.xml --post-destructive-changes destructiveChanges/destructiveChanges.xml -c -l NoTestRun -g
ricwiz.deployCommand.description: The command used to deploy the generated package.xml.

ricwiz.importDataCommand.description: The command used to import data.

ricwiz.resetTrackingCommand.default: sf org disable tracking && sf project reset tracking --no-prompt
ricwiz.resetTrackingCommand.description: The command used to reset source tracking.

ricwiz.auditUsername.description: The Salesforce username to use when querying the SetupAuditTrail for changes.

ricwiz.auditHours.description: The default number of hours to look back when querying the SetupAuditTrail.

ricwiz.commitMessageSuffix.description: Suffix to append to the ticket ID in the auto-generated commit message (e.g., '- ' or ': ').

ricwiz.environments.description: Environments to which deploy branches will be created, defining the source branch as well.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
